sentence: This project studies how mechanical forces across epithelial cell-cell junctions and the nucleus regulate the homeostasis of epithelial cells and tissues.
This project tries to find out why acute myeloid leukemia cells become resistant to drugs, including causes inside tumor cells and from their local environment.
This project tests whether environmental toxic chemicals cause incomplete suppression of a human endogenous retrovirus in gamete-producing cells, raising cancer risk in the next generation.
This project studies rapid diagnostics for the diagnosis and treatment of infectious diseases, including HIV and tuberculosis.
This project studies how lung adenocarcinomas that have lost one particular protein respond to immunotherapy.
This project uses mass spectrometry to measure biomarkers of exposure in cell-culture based models, animal models and patient cohort studies.
This project builds risk scores that forecast hazardous substance use during adolescence using brain imaging, demographic, health and cognitive test data.
This project studies how donor selection and manufacturing methods change the potency of mesenchymal stem cells so they can be tailored to specific diseases.
This project studies anal and cervical cancers in different population groups, including groups at high risk of poor outcomes.
This project tries to find out whether extrachromosomal DNA explains why glioblastoma cells differ from one another and resist drugs.
This project studies how the antibiotic polymyxin interacts with a receptor in the kidney and designs inhibitors that could protect the kidney.
This project studies how exosomes released by cancer cells and fibroblasts affect cancer cell adhesion, migration and extracellular matrix assembly.
This project builds a classroom research program on evolutionary biology and microbiology using authentic experimentation and bioinformatic skills.
This project studies how nutrients and interactions between microbes shape bacterial colonization and persistence in the vaginal mucosa.
This project examines how losing risk genes for neurodevelopmental and psychiatric disorders changes molecules, cells, neural circuits and behavior in mice.
This project studies how alcohol exposure during adolescence disrupts signaling of a receptor in the amygdala, using electrophysiology, transcriptional profiling and functional connectivity mapping.
This project builds patient-specific models that forecast sepsis infection in cancer patients with chemotherapy-induced neutropenia, using machine learning and mathematical modeling.
This project tries to find out how influenza viruses cause lung injury during viral lung infection.
This project uses whole genome sequencing and biomarker data from African and African American individuals to find rare genetic variants that affect Alzheimer's disease risk and protection.
